name: within_cell_gaussian_copula
population: Equal mixture of the four supplied sex/age cells; anatomical right and left hands; each hand value is the mean of three trials.
marginal_handling: Preserve every supplied right and left marker exactly. Change only their within-cell pairing.

dependence.status: Explicit modeling assumption, not estimated or identified by the source.
dependence.rationale: A positive association represents shared person-level strength. The value 0.8 is a transparent strong-positive working assumption, not an empirically calibrated coefficient.

pairing_algorithm: Within each cell, assign midpoint normal scores to ascending right ranks. Generate independent standard-normal innovations and form left scores as 0.8 times the right score plus sqrt(1-0.8^2) times the innovation. Assign ascending supplied left values to ascending left scores. Draw innovations independently across cells.
trial_handling: Do not simulate individual attempts or average additional trials: the supplied marginal strengths already represent three-trial hand means.
weighting: Each cell receives weight one quarter. No source sample-size weights are inferred.
